name: agent-hub-monorepo
description: A local desktop inbox for coding agents

scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @agent-hub/core && npm run test --workspace @agent-hub/daemon
scripts.dev:daemon: npm run build --workspace @agent-hub/core && npm run build --workspace @agent-hub/daemon && node packages/daemon/dist/index.js
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build && npm run dev --workspace @agent-hub/desktop
